note: The engine's look presets fetch their HDRI from /hdri/<name>.hdr at the origin root. vite.config.ts serves the repo's shared public/hdri/ files in dev and preview and copies these two (with public/hdri/ATTRIBUTION.md) into dist/hdri/ at build time (plugin wonder-world-copy-shared-public-files; a missing file fails the build). The app keeps no copy of its own.
